name: ship_kernel
supersedes: build/stages/S4_ship_kernel.reread.json PASS of 2026-08-23, which agreed on the verdict but recorded a disagreement: 'S4 priority list also asked to delete F18 and then fix emitters. Those items are not done.' That was true when written. Each item was re-checked against a product generated from merged master and is recorded below with what was actually run.
method: Generated a warehouse-operations product from origin/master@5d37eb71 via product_architect.generate_product, then inspected the emitted tree. Counts are from that build, not from the emitter source alone.

F18_fabrication_deleted.evidence: grep -c '_ALWAYS_FILL|_default_block_field' backend/app/factory/build/roles.py -> 0. The _DISPATCH_RUNTIME template no longer fabricates metric/value/query/steps or a {'status':'ok'} envelope.

F7_filter_sort_page.evidence: app/store.py emits query(); app/routes.py refuses unknown query fields (2 sites). Exercised on a live product: ?status=open returned 2 of 3, ?limit=1&offset=2 returned the third row, ?sort=quantity&order=desc ordered correctly, and ?staus=open / ?sort=1;DROP+TABLE+audit / ?limit=99999 were each refused. Closed by #190.

F24_fail_closed_health.evidence: app/health.py emitted with 12 dependency-check references; render.yaml sets healthCheckPath: /health; app/main.py lifespan calls upgrade_head() so a revision behind head refuses boot. A prior report of F24 as open was a false negative from grepping products for /ready, which is the factory's endpoint, not the product's.

F28_observability.evidence: app/observe.py emitted, 7 request_id references; JSON request lines observed live ("POST /v1/audit 200" with request_id)

F9_one_datastore.evidence: no .db files committed in the emitted tree; schema applied by Alembic, not by connect()

F10_requirements_reconciled.evidence: Reconciled every third-party import in the emitted tree against requirements.txt + requirements-dev.txt. Found starlette imported at runtime by app/observe.py and undeclared -- satisfied only transitively via fastapi. Declared it explicitly; re-reconciled: MISSING FROM BOTH -> none.

not_closed_and_not_claimed.F17_capture_ocr: N/A for this product rather than closed: the warehouse blueprint binds no capture block, so the emitted lockfile has no capture entry. A blueprint that binds it has not been re-checked here.
not_closed_and_not_claimed.F11_uninvoked_block_ids: Satisfied by construction, NOT enforced. The deterministic handler template loops over BLOCK_IDS and executes each, so no emitted handler declares a block it does not reach -- verified across the emitted actions. There is still no gate that would fail a build if one did. Recorded as an open enforcement gap, not a closure.
not_closed_and_not_claimed.F16_ui_schema_canonical_shape: NOT VERIFIED. Two factory modules reference ui_schema; the round-trip adapter between the block.json array shape and the Python class dict shape was not exercised in this reread.

not_claimed: That inspect_pilot_cycle ties the proven pilot cycle to the revision under promotion -- it does not; that needs an artifact-identity comparison
